answer.original_source: NVIDIA Corporation (NVIDIA blog post dated 2026-07-01, title: NVIDIA Unlocks AI Compute at Scale, Inviting Partners to Power the AI Infrastructure Buildout)
answer.new_information: Party statement by NVIDIA Corporation dated 2026-07-01 that it is introducing a new business model under which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure for AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers through economic alignment with a revenue-sharing and credit-support model. NVIDIA says it will earn both standard product revenue and a share of cloud revenue on the supported capacity, which it describes as a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream. No dollar amounts, revenue-share percentages, credit-support size, term, counterparties' contract signing status, or accounting treatment are stated. The claim supports a limited fact that NVIDIA has announced the model and its intended economics. It does not establish signed contracts, the scale of any guarantee or financing exposure, or realized revenue. Related items: Sharon AI CEO James Manning (quoted by NVIDIA) calls the collaboration with NVIDIA a pivotal moment for sovereign AI compute, with no terms given; NVIDIA says AI cloud companies are building DSX AI factories across regions, with no count or timing; NVIDIA says Firmus is building a DSX AI factory campus in Batam, Indonesia expected to scale to 360 megawatts and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs, which is a forward plan by an unspecified party with no build timeline, financing or contract confirmed in the text. Baseten, Fireworks AI and Together AI are named as examples of AI-native demand with no contract linkage stated. Inference from the text: if credit support is extended to AI clouds, NVIDIA could carry guarantee-type or purchase-type exposures in future periods, and revenue-share income could become a usage-linked component of NVIDIA revenue. Both are conditional on terms not yet disclosed.
answer.reason: Propose a new question because the claim describes a distinct investment judgement about whether NVIDIA's revenue-sharing and credit-support model creates material guarantee, financing or purchase obligations and a usage-linked revenue stream, which no catalog question carries (the catalog is empty). Admission reasons: a financing, guarantee or purchase obligation (credit support extended to AI clouds, unsigned and unquantified) and a major business model milestone. Public evidence that will settle it: NVIDIA's next annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal 2027 (fiscal year ending around late January 2027) and subsequent 10-Q filings, which should disclose guarantees, commitments, revenue-share arrangements, deferred or contingent revenue, and any new revenue line tied to cloud capacity; plus any named signed agreements with AI clouds such as Sharon AI or Firmus. Check period: next annual filing (fiscal 2027 10-K) with a future signing check within 18 months of 2026-07-01, i.e., by about 2028-01. Nearest catalog question: none exists in the supplied catalog. Folding into a general NVIDIA demand question would lose the separate question of contingent guarantee and revenue-share exposure, which carries different risk and disclosure channels than product sales. Other numbers in the text, such as Firmus 360 MW and 170,000 GPUs, are a forward plan by an unnamed build party and are evidence only, not a basis for the NVIDIA-level question.
answer.independent_judgement: The incoming NVIDIA statement is a party announcement with no quantified terms. It supports only that NVIDIA has announced a revenue-sharing and credit-support model for AI clouds and intends to earn product revenue plus a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity. Customer and partner examples (Sharon AI, Firmus, Baseten, Fireworks AI, Together AI) are not confirmed contracts with NVIDIA and their stated capacity is a plan, not NVIDIA revenue or orders. The unresolved issue is the size and timing of credit-support obligations and revenue-share income, which the next NVIDIA annual and quarterly filings should show. No existing catalog question or stored piece is affected, so the action is propose_new.
answer.new_question: Will NVIDIA's filings for fiscal 2027 disclose material guarantees, credit support, purchase commitments or revenue-share arrangements with AI cloud operators under its new revenue-sharing model, and how large are they relative to NVIDIA's product revenue?
